edges.reason: msg.sender from Context._msgSender() is written into the _owner state variable during Ownable construction.
msg.sender receives the entire _tTotal minted into _balances in the token constructor.
newComer is initialized from _msgSender() at deployment, establishing a caller-derived privileged credential.
msg.sender is used as the owner argument of _approve inside approve().
msg.sender is used as spender and allowance lookup key inside transferFrom().
msg.sender is used as the sender argument of _transfer inside transfer().
msg.sender is the value tested against newComer by the onlyOwner require statement, so the caller controls gate passage.
The identity derived from msg.sender ultimately determines whether the zero-allowance branch of _approve executes.
The cached newComer value is read by the onlyOwner require, granting the deployer-time caller privileged access.
owner() returns _owner, which _approve compares against the ol argument to decide whether to zero the allowance.
owner() reads and returns the _owner state variable.
The constructor writes the initial supply into _balances.
balanceOf reads _balances[account].
_transfer reads and writes _balances for sender and recipient.
_approve writes _allowances[ol][tt] either with zero+event or with the supplied amount.
allowance reads the _allowances nested mapping.
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][msg.sender] to compute the reduced amount.
The constructor reads _tTotal to mint the entire supply.
totalSupply returns _tTotal.
name() returns the _name state variable.
symbol() returns the _symbol state variable.
decimals() returns the _decimals state variable.
Execution inside _approve enters the branch that zeroes allowances for any owner argument that is not owner().
The onlyOwner modifier gate built on newComer guards entry into renounceOwnership.
The onlyOwner modifier gate built on newComer guards entry into transferOwnership.
approve delegates its logic to the internal _approve routine.
transferFrom first invokes _transfer to move the tokens.
transferFrom then invokes _approve to update the spender allowance.
transfer delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
The sender parameter of _transfer is used as the debited balance key.
The recipient parameter of _transfer is used as the credited balance key.
The amount parameter of _transfer feeds the SafeMath sub/add balance updates.
The spender parameter of approve is forwarded into _approve.
The ol parameter of _approve is compared with owner() to select the allowance branch.
The tt parameter of _approve is used as the allowance spender key and Approval argument.
The newOwner parameter of transferOwnership is validated and written into _owner.

normalization_plan.reason: The sender parameter only exists to key the _balances debit performed by _transfer, so it can be folded into that function node.
The recipient parameter only exists to key the _balances credit performed by _transfer, so it can be folded into that function node.
The amount parameter is consumed solely by the SafeMath sub/add balance updates inside _transfer.
The spender parameter flows directly from approve into _approve and carries no independent semantics.
The ol parameter is the value compared against owner() and therefore belongs to the _approve zero-allowance unsafe operation.
The tt parameter is the spender key written by _approve and can be merged into that routine.
The newOwner parameter is validated and stored exclusively by the private transferOwnership function.
